branding.tagline: Coastal luxury with private pool and ocean views

blocks.title: Property Overview
blocks.subtitle: Private villa
blocks.description: A contemporary cliffside villa with panoramic ocean views, heated infinity pool, and concierge-style guest services.

property.name: Sunset Bay Villa
property.shortDescription: A contemporary cliffside villa with panoramic ocean views, heated infinity pool, and concierge-style guest services.

blocks.title: Welcome Message
blocks.subtitle: We are delighted to host you
blocks.message: Thank you for choosing Sunset Bay Villa. This digital guide includes WiFi details, house rules, appliance instructions, local recommendations, and emergency contacts. Your host team is available throughout your stay.

blocks.title: WiFi
blocks.notes: Fiber internet throughout the villa, pool deck, and guest suite. QR code for one-tap connection is on the kitchen counter card.

items.label: Check-in / Check-out
items.value: Check-in from 4:00 PM. Check-out by 11:00 AM.

items.label: Quiet hours
items.value: 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM. Please keep music low on the terrace.

items.label: Pool safety
items.value: No glass near the pool. Children must be supervised at all times.

items.label: Events
items.value: Small gatherings up to 12 guests require prior approval.

items.instructions: Use the wall panel in the hallway or the guest tablet. Recommended comfort setting: 22°C.
Only magnetic cookware. Power button for 3 seconds to unlock child safety mode.
Pool is pre-heated to 28°C. Towels are in the cabana cabinet.
Connect to SunsetBay_Audio via the Sonos app. Do not change wired speaker pairing.

items.name: Private Chef
items.description: Seasonal menus and wine pairings. Book at least 24 hours in advance.

items.name: Daily Housekeeping
items.description: Mid-stay refresh available on request between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM.

items.name: Airport Transfer
items.description: Private driver service to and from the regional airport.

items.name: Harbor Grill
items.description: Fresh seafood and sunset views. Reservations recommended on weekends.

items.name: Crescent Bay Beach
items.description: Calm water ideal for swimming and paddleboarding. Public access 8 minutes by car.

items.name: Coastal Wine Route
items.description: Three boutique wineries within a 30-minute scenic drive.

blocks.title: Getting Here
blocks.airport: Regional airport transfers take approximately 45 minutes. Your driver will meet you at arrivals with a Sunset Bay sign.
blocks.taxi: Licensed taxis are available at the airport rank. Ride-share apps operate in the area.
blocks.bus: Coastal shuttle stops at the village center, 10 minutes by car from the villa.
blocks.metro: No metro service in this area.
blocks.rentalCar: On-site parking for two vehicles. EV charger available in the garage.
blocks.parking: Gated driveway with keypad code shared at check-in.
blocks.walkingInfo: Cliffside walking path to the village begins at the end of the driveway.

items.question: Is early check-in available?
items.answer: Early check-in depends on the previous booking. Message your host after 12:00 PM on arrival day.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: One well-behaved dog is welcome with prior approval and a cleaning fee.

items.question: Is the pool heated year-round?
items.answer: Yes, the infinity pool is heated and maintained daily.

blocks.title: Emergency Contacts
blocks.hospital: Coastal Medical Center — 18 minutes by car
blocks.pharmacy: Village Pharmacy — open daily until 9:00 PM
